description: My customer wants to ship flammable liquids (class 3) in their own container. Can I quote a hazardous cargo on a SOC line, or do I need a specific HAZ line?
What does the SOC flag mean on a price line, and why is the SOC rate on Le Havre to Shanghai lower than the standard rate?
Price list PL-2026-041 line 12 shows USD 1850 for a 40HC Le Havre to Shanghai, but quote QS-10231 for the same lane says USD 2150 per container. The customer is asking which one is correct.
Blue Harbor Foods was quoted USD 1950 for a 40HC Marseille to Singapore last month (QS-10198). Today the new quote QS-10240 is USD 2100. The customer wants to know why the price went up.
Quote QS-10236 for a 20ST Antwerp to New York is USD 1420, but the price line I see is USD 1200. Is the quote wrong?
Please confirm the 40HC rate of USD 2600 on PL-2026-052 line 7 (Rotterdam to Santos, coffee) so I can send it to the customer today.
Verde Coffee accepted quote QS-10245 (3 x 40HC Rotterdam to Santos). Can we go ahead and book it?
For Hamburg to Ningbo FAK there are two active lines in PL-2026-055 (line 2 at USD 1800 and line 3 at USD 1880 for 40HC) and both are valid on 20 November. Which one applies to a quote made today?
Quote QS-10250 from Lyon to Shanghai has no inland pre-carriage (INL00), so the customer price is missing the trucking to Le Havre. How do I get the inland rate added?
No INL00 pre-carriage for Strasbourg via Antwerp. The guide explains how to check the inland tariff, but not what to do when the rate is not there.
Toulouse to Singapore via Marseille: the inland tariff table has no pre-carriage rate. Who can add it?
Customer in Dijon needs door pickup to Rotterdam for Santos. QuotePort shows no inland charge. Is there a request process?
Second request this week for Lyon pre-carriage: still no INL00 in the inland tariff table, so all Lyon quotes are understated.
QuotePort returns 'no offer' when I select lithium batteries for Le Havre to Shanghai. The commodity does not appear in the list. What should I do?
How do I turn an accepted quote into a booking, and how long is a quote valid once it is sent?
Booking BK-55012 shows a total of USD 4300, but the customer remembers a price of USD 1850 per container on quote QS-10231. Is the booking amount wrong?
Where can I find what changed in TideRate 3.2?
Who should I contact when a pricing question cannot be answered by the hypercare team?
What changed for draft price lines in TideRate 3.3? Some of my lines now show the DRAFT status.
Can you confirm the 40HC rate on PL-2026-047 line 7, Genoa to Singapore? I want to send it to Riviera Tiles.
QuotePort takes more than a minute to load the quote screen this morning. Is there a known incident?
Riviera Tiles will ship 40 containers Marseille to Singapore next quarter. Can I apply a volume discount on the current all-in rate?
The price is wrong for my customer, please fix it as soon as possible.
The rate looks much higher than last week. Can someone check?
In the Dynamic Pricing demo video, how is the floor price determined, and how often are dynamic prices refreshed?
What is the difference between BAF and LSS, and are they always included in the price shown to the customer?
Acme Retail wants to book at the price of quote QS-10150 (USD 2050 per 40HC), but QuotePort says the quote has expired. Can I still use it?
Lille pre-carriage was missing; resolved after the pricing team loaded the rate.
Please confirm I can still quote PL-2026-061 line 4 (Valencia to Shanghai, USD 1900 for 40HC).
A route is missing from the routing tool for Genoa to Port Klang. Who manages routing data?
